result.title: Relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license
result.summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5914

SPONSOR: LANZA
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to waiving
certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's
license

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance
of an enhanced driver's license

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section one of this bill amends subdivision 3 of section 503 of the
vehicle and traffic law to waive any additional fee associated with the
request for an enhanced driver's license if such request is made within
thirty days of the issuance of reissuance of a standard driver's
license.

Section two is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill would allow a person to upgrade to and enhanced drivers with-
out paying an additional fee to the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV).
For example, when someone goes to DMV to get a standard driver's license
they may not know until after the fact, that they have the option to
upgrade to an enhanced license which requires more stringent documenta-
tion. The 30 day window allows residents to obtain the proper documenta-
tion that is required in order to get an enhanced license thus waiving
any additional fees associated with the upgrade above the standard cost
of the enhanced license. This bill ensures that any fee associated with
upgrading to such license is exempt when it is done within 30 days after
a standard license has been issued.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2024:S.4212 - Referred to Transportation

2023:S.4212 - Referred to Transportation

2022:S.4978 - 3rd Reading Calendar

2021:S.4978 - Referred to Finance

2020:S.3178 - Referred to Transportation

2019:S.3178 - Referred to Transportation

2018:S.8280 - Referred to Transportation

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the thirtieth day after it shall have
become a law.

 Introduced  by  Sen.  LANZA  -- read twice and ordered printed, and when

 AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic  law,  in  relation  to  waiving
   certain  fees  associated  with  the  issuance of an enhanced driver's
   license

   THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK, REPRESENTED IN SENATE AND  ASSEM-
 BLY, DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS:
 
   Section  1.  Subdivision  3  of section 503 of the vehicle and traffic
 law, as amended by chapter 548 of the laws of 1986 and paragraph (i)  as
 amended  by  chapter  322  of  the  laws  of 2021, is amended to read as
 follows:
   3. Waiver of fee. (A) The commissioner may waive the payment  of  fees
 required by subdivision two of this section if the applicant:
   (i)  is  an incarcerated individual in an institution under the juris-
 diction of a state department or agency, or
   (ii) is a victim of crime and the driver's license or learner's permit
 applied for is a replacement for one that was lost  or  destroyed  as  a
 result of the crime.
   (B)  THE  COMMISSIONER  SHALL WAIVE ANY ADDITIONAL FEE ASSOCIATED WITH
 THE REQUEST FOR AN ENHANCED DRIVER'S LICENSE IF  SUCH  REQUEST  IS  MADE
 WITHIN  THIRTY DAYS OF THE ISSUANCE OR REISSUANCE OF A STANDARD DRIVER'S
 LICENSE. FOR PURPOSES OF THIS PARAGRAPH, "ADDITIONAL FEE" SHALL MEAN ANY
 FEE IN EXCESS OF THE STANDARD FEE ASSESSED FOR  SUCH  ENHANCED  DRIVER'S
 LICENSE.
   §  2.  This  act shall take effect on the thirtieth day after it shall
 have become a law.
